description: This file defines a ref struct `ExecutionContextSuppressor` that suppresses and restores the flow of `ExecutionContext` within a scope, ensuring that the execution context flow is temporarily halted and then restored upon disposal.

methods.name: ExecutionContextSuppressor
methods.description: Constructor that suppresses the flow of the `ExecutionContext` if not already suppressed.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Restores the flow of the `ExecutionContext` if it was suppressed by this instance.
